title: In-place electric EIR chiller reference ratings

reference_cop.description: Explicit reference cooling watts per electric watt at the retained reference conditions; not IPLV or seasonal COP. Values below 2 or above 10 trigger a non-blocking unit/rating plausibility warning; explicit inputs are not converted.

reference_capacity_w.description: Explicit reference cooling capacity in thermal watts, or Autosize using retained plant sizing and chiller sizing factor. No flow or sizing-factor changes are inferred.

minimum_part_load_ratio.description: Explicit ratio; require minimum <= optimum <= maximum and minimum <= unloading <= maximum. No companion reset or Autosize.

maximum_part_load_ratio.description: Explicit ratio; require minimum <= optimum <= maximum and minimum <= unloading <= maximum. No companion reset or Autosize.

optimum_part_load_ratio.description: Explicit ratio; require minimum <= optimum <= maximum and minimum <= unloading <= maximum. No companion reset or Autosize.

minimum_unloading_ratio.description: Explicit ratio; require minimum <= optimum <= maximum and minimum <= unloading <= maximum. No companion reset or Autosize.
